mu_name: The ring of fire a wizard's Inferno lays round him
why_this_one: Inferno's one model, made with CreateInferno's eight bombs at the let-go (ZzzCharacter.cpp:4574-4583) at his position and angle, sub-type 0. game/fx/inferno.h draws it.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Skill/Inferno01.bmd, from MuMain's clean Data, --action=0 --key=N: two meshes, 548 triangles. ring3 (540) is a wall of fire from 56 to 385 units out and 12 to 245 up; ring4 (8) a square 800 units across, flat at 86 up.
poses_from: Its action stepped at Velocity 0.5 keys a frame over a LifeTime of 15 reaches 7.5 keys, and BMD::Animation blends a key with the next, so keys 0 to 8. The animation is spin and nothing else: the square and the wall's rim turn +30 degrees a key and the wall's inner rows -45, at constant radius and height, so fx/inferno.h blends the keys as a turn.

parts.note: Data/Skill/ring3.OZJ, 64 x 128, mean (34, 19, 14): dark fire, only ever added. BlendMesh -2 adds every mesh, at BlendMeshLight = LifeTime / 20 under its Light of 0.8 (ZzzEffect.cpp:1378-1388, MoveHandlers.cpp:2675).
Data/Skill/ring4.OZJ, 128 square, mean (58, 26, 21). The same blend and light.

frames_from: `o->LifeTime = 15` for sub-type 0: six tenths of a second.
light_from: `AddTerrainLight` at (-0.5, -0.5, -0.5) x Luminosity over five tiles for every sub-type under 4 but 2 - the ground darkened under the ring. Not ported: the renderer only adds.
